- **Context, Harness, and Prompt Engineering**: Emphasis on designing systems by first considering the harness, then context, and finally the prompt, along with proper tool calls and role/persona definition for agents [17 August 2026, Page 13-14 — Siddharth Saminathan].

- The knowledge base and RAG components are shared, and Himaya is not building separate rerankers or knowledge base components for her system [17 August 2026, Page 5 — Siddharth Saminathan].
